name: starter
description: A small, opinionated user-level setup: ask-before-assuming and verify-before-done rules injected at session start, a review gate, opt-in fan-out of approved plans through a Sonnet workflow with one fresh review, safe worktree cleanup, role agents that fix model and effort (locator, reader, writer, reviewer), diff-walkthrough and visual-plan skills, and a monthly review with optional context7 and obscura MCP servers.
